summary: Main site navigation with links and expandable groups (disclosure pattern).
whenToUse: Site and portal headers with sections and subsections.
whenNotToUse: Actions on an item: use DropdownMenu.
Alternative content on the same page: use Tabs.

props.name: items
props.description: Links ({ id, label, href, description?, current?, linkProps? }) or groups ({ id, label, items }).

props.name: orientation
props.description: Horizontal: flyout panels. Vertical: always-visible groups.

keyboard.action: Moves through group buttons and links.
Closes the open group and returns focus to its button.

accessibility: APG “Disclosure navigation” pattern: buttons with aria-expanded and aria-controls, real links.
The current page link has aria-current="page".
The panel closes when focus leaves it or on an outside click.
Does not use role="menu": links stay links (the approach recommended by the APG for site navigation).
responsive: On mobile, use the vertical orientation inside a Drawer (see AppShell) or BottomNavigation.
Items wrap; panels have a maximum width limited to the viewport.
commonMistakes: Using groups without direct links for important pages.

examples.name: CurrentPage
examples.title: Current page managed by state
examples.description: current and linkProps.onPress update aria-current; the Servizi group indicates when it contains the current page.

examples.name: LongLabels
examples.title: Long labels in limited space
examples.description: Long items and descriptions wrap without horizontal overflow.

limits: A single level of groups: for deeper hierarchies use a dedicated side navigation.
